name: Asian Paints

snapshot.about: Asian Paints exists to beautify, transform and preserve spaces and objects, bringing happiness to the world.

narrative: Management targeted 18% to 20% PBDIT margins and mid-single-digit value growth for FY26. The reported numbers aligned well, with FY26 consolidated PBDIT margin reaching 18.9% and decorative value growing 4.3%. In Q1 FY27, revenue expanded 17.9% with an EBITDA margin of 21.0%.

promises.statement: Management expects mid-single-digit value growth for full year FY26.

said.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management targets maintaining an 18% to 20% PBDIT margin band.

said.quote: it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Management expects volume growth to be in the band of 8% to 10%.

said.quote: No, I think I have been maintaining that, as I said that, band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator

actual_source.quote: On a yearly level, volume growth is close to about 9%, which is quite commendable, and the value growth is about 4.3%

promises.note: Decorative volume growth for full year FY26 reached close to 9%, falling within the 8% to 10% band.

promises.statement: Management guides PBDIT margins to remain between 18% and 20%.

said.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain

actual_source.quote: PBDIT grew in double-digits, and PBDIT margins at 18.9%, higher by almost 110 bps

promises.note: Full year FY26 consolidated PBDIT margin arrived at 18.9%, comfortably inside the 18% to 20% target range.

said.quote: We are looking at the price increases that are happening and trying to see that we get into that area of 8-10% volume growth

actual_source.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth

said.quote: Just to understand clearly that in doing so, you would like to maintain your margin guidance, which has always been 18-20%

cash.read: Profits convert strongly into cash. Operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore over FY22–FY26 fully covered the reported cumulative net profit of ₹20,943 crore.

bull.point: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 17.9% year-on-year to ₹10,542 crore with net profit surging 39.6% to ₹1,559 crore and an EBITDA margin of 21.0%.

evidence.quote: In fact, it improved to about an 18% top line growth
PBDIT margins stand at about 20.6%, almost 240 bps higher YoY

bull.point: Operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore over FY22–FY26 comfortably exceeded reported cumulative net profits of ₹20,943 crore over the same period.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹22,795 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹20,943 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Decorative business volume grew 12.4% with value growing 10.2% in Q4 FY26, bringing full-year volume growth close to 9%.

evidence.quote: When we look at the decorative business, we have achieved 12.4% volume growth and a very strong value growth of 10.2%
On a yearly level, volume growth is close to about 9%, which is quite commendable, and the value growth is about 4.3%

bear.point: Competition Commission of India ordered an investigation into alleged abuse of dominant position, creating potential legal and financial regulatory uncertainties.

evidence.quote: The CCI had passed a prima facie order dated 1st July 2025 directing the Director General (DG) to conduct an investigation against the Company

bear.point: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹488.74 crore at the end of FY26, with significant sums locked in disputed tax litigation before appellate authorities.

evidence.quote: It is not practicable for the Company to estimate the timings of cash outflows, if any, in respect of the pending resolution of the respective proceedings
